content.title: Chapter 62 - OFFENSES — Sec. 62-44. - Interference with city official.
content.summary:
No person shall willfully hinder, obstruct or otherwise interfere with any city official
               or employee of the city in the discharge of his official duties.
(Code 1960, § 17-22; Code 1981, § 21-13)
State Law reference—
Obstructing government operations, C.R.S. § 18-8-102.
